name: Original tailored field garment and painted armor masks
authorship: Original project-authored garment patterns, relief and masks. Existing Quaternius CC0 body UVs/bind-space used for placement; no body geometry is included in these maps.
usage: Only model.surface=field with body=superhero-male uses garment maps. Original scalar armor materials retain palette ownership. Standard and other body UV layouts do not use the garment maps.
textureContract: 1024px; NoColorSpace; flipY=false; repeat 1x1; normalScale 1. Roughness map is absolute (scalar roughness 1).
maskContract: Optional normalized Uint8 fieldWear attribute, existing vertex ordering; default [1,0,0] on unmasked shared-armor geometry.
